tmp:0579: gai (גיא) — 'the valley' where Moses was buried (Deut 34:6), read as bittul/ayin (self-nullification into nothingness) via Isaiah 40:4 'every valley shall be raised'; not gei as mere topography
tmp:0581: doing the mitzvot with joy (asiyat ha-mitzvot b'simchah) — the devotional practice/state of joyful mitzvah-performance, linked to the thought's pursuit of the Ein Sof light in 'reaching and not reaching'
tmp:0583: oneg Shabbat — the mitzvah-state of Sabbath delight, whose holy eating accomplishes what fasting does (subduing the liver/enemy), rendering fasts unnecessary
tmp:0584: galgalta d'mocha atum b'tum'ah — Aramaic kabbalistic image of the skull (galgalta) enclosing the brain being sealed/blocked by ritual impurity, so the voice cannot resound as thunder
tmp:0585: ein kolo nishma — the state of 'his voice is not heard': one's prayer-voice fails to resound as thunder because the skull/brain is blocked by impurity (per Berakhot 24b idiom)
tmp:0586: ein kashin lo mezonotav — the reward-state that one's livelihood does not come with difficulty: sustenance without toil, earned by honest business dealings that make Heaven's Name beloved
tmp:0588: the condition that the brazen-faced (azei panim) hold no appointment or authority — denial of office/serarah to the impudent, dependent on restored holy Malkhut/honor
tmp:0590: casting no shadow and receiving God's light — the state of one whose deeds make no 'shadow' blocking the ever-flowing divine light, so no lack (children, livelihood, health) befalls him
tmp:0592: 'this counsel' (etzah zot) — Rabbi Nachman's specific advice of finding God's light even in darkness/descents (exits through the openings of another's fall), enabling lifelong integrity
tmp:0593: ish kasher be'emet kol yemei chayav — the state of being a truly upright/kosher person one's whole life, attained by ever reviving oneself through the truth that is God's own light
tmp:0595: 'teref natan lire'av' (Ps 111:5) — the verse 'He gave prey/food to those who fear Him,' linked to the altar in the portion of Binyamin 'the ravener' (toref); emblem of eating in kashrut/holiness
tmp:0598: the triad of eating, drinking, and garments (akhilah, shetiyah, malbushim) — the three bodily provisions all contained within and flowing from da'at of the Torah (manna, well, clouds of glory)
tmp:0600: Birkat ha-Mazon — the Grace after Meals blessings, by which food is blessed through arousing and illuminating the holy letters (of the 32 Elokim of Creation) present in the food
tmp:0602: el acher — 'the other god,' the idolatrous demonic power identified in Tikkunei Zohar with the fool's laughter/spleen/Lilith, mother of the Erev Rav; not the word 'other' generically
tmp:0605: katnut ha-mochin — constricted consciousness/immature mentalities, the stagnant mind-state of the divine name Elokim and stern judgments, opposite of renewal of mind
tmp:0609: panim d'Sitra Achra — the 'faces of the Other Side': dark countenances (anpin chashokhin) of melancholy and idolatry ('other gods upon My face'), borne by those sunk in money-craving
tmp:0612: 'these waters' — the waters of dispute/machaloket, the Mei Merivah (waters of strife, Num 20:13), the peleg-channel from which controversy and its resulting books of questions-and-answers flow
tmp:0613: alfei (in Ps 68:18 'alfei shin'an') — 'thousands' read as the alufei (chieftains) of Esav, the impure powers nullified through receiving of the Torah
tmp:0616: nashin shapirin — Aramaic 'beautiful women' whom R. Shimon bar Yochai saw and called 'idols' (Zohar Kedoshim), emblem of lustful thoughts as idolatrous folly
tmp:0617: elilim — 'idols' of Lev 19:4 ('turn not to the idols'), applied by R. Shimon bar Yochai to beautiful women: lustful fantasies equated with idol-worship's madness
tmp:0619: ilmim — 'the mute/silent ones': silence (shetikah) personified as muteness, the guarded restraint of speech as a spiritual practice/state
tmp:0620: em — 'mother' as title of the tzaddik of the generation, who nurses Israel with the milk of his Torah (Song 4:11 'honey and milk under your tongue'); not the conditional word 'im'
tmp:0621: 'if he merits, he can receive double' — the Elisha-like opportunity at a tzaddik's passing to receive pi shenayim (a twofold portion) of his revealed descending spirit
tmp:0622: returning people in teshuvah — the tzaddik's action of bringing others to repentance, equated with 'extracting the precious from the vile' (Jer 15:19)
tmp:0623: 'im totzi yakar mi-zolel' (Jer 15:19) — the verse 'if you extract the precious from the vile,' prooftext for making converts and penitents, whereby glory is elevated
tmp:0628: ima al bera — kabbalistic term 'Mother upon the Son' (Binah brooding over Ze'ir Anpin), the configuration embodied in tefillin per Tikkunei Zohar, linked to 'im la-Binah tikra'
tmp:0630: amah bat shishah tefachim — 'the cubit of six handbreadths' as Talmudic euphemism for the male organ/brit, whose six units correspond to the seraph's six wings (sod of milah)
tmp:0632: our seeking and yearning for Eretz Yisrael — the practice of praying for kisufin/ga'agu'im (longings) for the Land of Israel, a segulah against anger and sadness
tmp:0634: Elokei avikha — 'the God of your father' (I Chr 28:9), signifying inherited emunah: faith in God as the God of our fathers ('deeds of their fathers in their hands')
tmp:0635: yir'at ha-onesh — fear of punishment, the lower of the two fears (vs. yir'at ha-romemut, awe of God's exaltedness), termed 'tzedek'
tmp:0636: 'the clarification/birur of the foods' — the kabbalistic sorting of holy sparks in food, accomplished through emunah (faith beyond intellect's answerable questions)
tmp:0637: ulimta shapirta — the Zohar Saba de-Mishpatim's 'beautiful maiden without eyes,' symbol of emunah/faith ('you are beautiful, my beloved... nurture faith'), hidden yet revealed
tmp:0640: ha'amadat ha-melekh — 'appointing the king,' the first of the three mitzvot upon entering the Land (Sanhedrin 20b), identified here as the aspect of emunah/faith
tmp:0643: tikvah — 'hope' (and the tikvat-cord of scarlet thread of Rachav, Josh 2), identified as emunah, the 'end of days' foundation upon which all middot stand (Habakkuk's 'one')
tmp:0644: ro'im — 'the shepherds' (the seven shepherd-tzaddikim) from whom emunah is drawn, approachable only through holy boldness (azut) attained via joy
tmp:0646: 'ragli amdah be-mishor' (Ps 26:12) — 'my foot stands on level ground,' verse-emblem of emunah as firm standing, the leveling that nullifies idolatry/heresy
tmp:0647: saviv — 'around/surrounding' (Targum: sechor, whence 'socher,' merchant), signifying emunah per Ps 89:9 'Your faithfulness surrounds You'
tmp:0649: drawing near and cleaving to them (the tzaddikim) — the act of hitkarvut/devekut to the generation's tzaddikim, through which one receives emunah, the 'faithful city' Jerusalem
tmp:0651: 've-alayikh yizrach Hashem' (Isa 60:2) — 'but upon you Hashem shall shine,' verse denoting faith in Godhood (emunat Elokut) as the light of the face piercing the darkness of livelihood-worry
tmp:0652: emtza'i — 'intermediary': the Shekhinah as the middle mediating principle that receives the Torah's fire and water and channels spiritual and material abundance
